name: Mediterranean Women's Wellness Day ($999 pp)
tagline: Mediterranean Women’s Wellness Day Experience (1 day)
body: All-Inclusive | Mediterranean Living & Luxury Wellness

A deeply restorative, Mediterranean-inspired one-day women’s wellness experience designed to help you live a healthier life, reduce stress and enhance longevity, all within a luxurious, boutique coastal retreat setting.

This science-led, nourishing wellness day invites you to reconnect with your health through the timeless principles of the Mediterranean diet and lifestyle, outdoor movement, plant-based nourishment, connection, community and pleasure.
Ideal for: Best friends, sisters & mother-daughter duos, all women welcome!
Limited Availability, 4 'DUO' Day Tickets Only (note: 1 ticket purchased for 2 people)
What You’ll Learn & Experience
• Learn how to implement healthy lifestyle habits that influence energy, mood, hormones and long-term vitality
• Explore the proven benefits of the Mediterranean diet & lifestyle for longevity, heart health, hormone health and brain health
• Gain practical, evidence-based tools to restore balance and support your body with confidence
• Experience deep restoration, meaningful connection and science-based education within a luxury setting
This Experience Is Perfect For Women Who Are:
• Seeking a science-backed, holistic approach to women’s wellness
• Wanting clarity, confidence and actionable strategies for lifelong health
• Feeling stressed, depleted or disconnected from their body
• Craving some restoration, meaningful connection & Mediterranean-style luxury
• Ready to prioritise themselves in a nourishing, sustainable way
Bespoke Day Guest Luxury Wellness Experience
Enjoy 1 full day of elevated luxury wellness, where you and your chosen wellness partner are completely taken care of from the moment you step into our private luxury transport.
This intimate duo-only experience is intentionally designed for connection, nourishment and restoration, offering a powerful wellness reset without an overnight stay.

With dedicated retreat hosts, multiple wellness experts in their chosen fields, and premium locally sourced South Australian food and beverages, every detail of your day is curated to feel seamless, indulgent and personalised.
• Tickets must be purchased as a duo (1 ticket for 2 people)
• Experiences can be tailored to you and your partner’s needs
• A pre-wellness day questionnaire will be sent prior to your experience so we can personalise your journey as deeply as possible
• Please review our booking terms & conditions prior to purchase
